criteria.text: POST /agent-sessions accepts isolateWorktree?: boolean and optional worktreeName, creates the worktree first, then creates the engine session with its directory as cwd.
Persist worktree name, path, and branch on the session row and expose them in session GET payloads.
Database migration adds worktree fields to agent_sessions; postgres_bootstrap.ts is not needed only if agent sessions are verified local-SQLite-only.
Hard delete optionally removes the worktree only with an explicit caller flag and keeps it by default.
Background agent runs (AgentRunner) support the same isolateWorktree option.
api_server provides getVcs() and getVcsStatus() wrappers and GET routes under /agent-sessions/:id/vcs.
The stream bridge explicitly relays vcs.branch.updated as a typed WS frame.
The transcript header shows branch name and dirty-file count with a tooltip listing files, and hides the badge outside a git repository.
The badge refreshes on vcs.branch.updated and on turn idle.
Picker visibility and specialist schedulability are independent; a selected hidden specialist can own scheduled/background jobs as its real profile.
Agent-file projection remains local-only and intentionally no-ops under dbClient === postgres.
The hidden specialist runs end-to-end through the real scheduler, AgentRunner, and engine as its real profile.
criteria.reason: Orchestrator explicitly reserves serial sandbox verification; this worktree must not run tools/dev/sandbox.sh.
